text:
Matthew Tkachuk has 23 assists in 19 games, and 16 of his 27 points have come on the power play. With Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand out, he's been Florida's offense, and he's on a five-game point streak with seven assists.

After a lost 2025-26 (34 points in 31 games, with Evolving-Hockey rating him barely above replacement), this is the Tkachuk the Panthers won two Cups with. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says the habits are intact: he carries the puck in on 69% of his entries and sits in the 95th percentile for primary shot assists.

The rate (4.52 points per 60) is above even the top of our range for him, so expect it to settle; power-play assists come in waves. He's also been in headlines this week for a Veterans Day post with his brother Brady that drew a backlash. Our range for the season: 82 to 114 points.
